sentence: This project expands a software platform that helps scientists study microbial communities in soils, oceans, and other environments that are not human.
This project tries to find out how bacteria make a type of ceramide lipid that lets them survive without lipopolysaccharide.
This project builds ways for nearby edge devices to share the work of neural network inference when the wireless network conditions change.
This project links a knowledge graph of biomedical information with space biology data to study how stress in space affects gene expression.
This project studies barley varieties that competed in different places for decades to find the genes behind their ability to adapt.
This project builds a simulated corporate information network that faces the same cyber-threats and data vulnerabilities as the real world.
This project builds a hybrid method that combines quantum and classical computing to design engineering structures more efficiently.
This project studies the optimal control of electromagnetic phenomena described by nonlinear equations, using both theory and numerical methods.
This project builds open-source tools to collect, label and share sign language videos and to recognize signs in them.
This project builds laser diodes from colloidal quantum shells, a layered nanomaterial designed to keep working efficiently under intense lasing conditions.
This project builds an AI model that predicts the electronic structure of solid materials in seconds, avoiding costly quantum mechanical simulations.
This project tries to find the genes behind the light hair, dark skin and hollow hair of polar bears.
This project studies how methylmercury affects the behavior, growth, reproduction and gene expression of spiders.
This project sets up a high-performance computing system with Graphic Processing Units to support artificial intelligence, modeling, and simulations across many disciplines.
This project creates a forensic science certificate program that combines chemistry, biology, biochemistry and criminal justice.
This project tests a model that brings genetics scientists together with community leaders and policymakers to guide the ethical design of genetic technologies.
